summary: Tungray Technologies Inc, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K to report the resignation of CFO Qi (Henry) Guo, effective September 4, 2026, for personal reasons unrelated to company operations. The departure is not described as forced or abrupt; Guo plans to focus on his other role at an investment bank. This is a routine management transition disclosure, not a special-situation event such as strategic, financial, or governance overhaul. Investors should monitor for CFO succession announcements, but the filing itself does not trigger a special-situation classification.
